name: PubMed article count
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) RETURN count(a) AS total_articles

name: MeSH term count
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm) RETURN count(m) AS total_mesh

name: Journal count
cypher: MATCH (j:Journal) RETURN count(j) AS total_journals

name: Articles by year distribution
cypher: MATCH (a:Article) WHERE a.pub_year >= 2020 RETURN a.pub_year, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY a.pub_year

name: Top 10 journals by article count
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(j:Journal) RETURN j.title, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 10

name: Author collaboration (multi-authored articles)
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(au:Author) WITH a, count(au) AS num_authors WHERE num_authors > 10 RETURN a.pmid, a.title, num_authors ORDER BY num_authors DESC LIMIT 5

name: MeSH terms co-occurrence
cypher: MATCH (m1:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m2:MeSHTerm) WHERE m1.name = 'Machine Learning' AND m1 <> m2 RETURN m2.name, count(a) AS co_occurs ORDER BY co_occurs DESC LIMIT 10

name: Chemical → Journal pathway
cypher: MATCH (c:Chemical)<-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]-(a:Article)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(j:Journal) WHERE c.name = 'Metformin' RETURN j.title, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 10

name: Clinical trial sponsors top 10
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:SPONSORED_BY]->(s:Sponsor) RETURN s.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Trials by country top 10
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_IN]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Conditions with most trials
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(c:Condition) RETURN c.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Interventions with most trials
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:TESTS]->(i:Intervention) RETURN i.name, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: Protein interaction count (STRING)
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(p2:Protein) RETURN count(*) AS total_interactions

name: GO term hierarchy depth
cypher: MATCH (g1:GOTerm)-[:IS_A]->(g2:GOTerm)-[:IS_A]->(g3:GOTerm) RETURN g1.name, g2.name, g3.name LIMIT 5

name: Pathway with most proteins
cypher: MATCH (pr:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN pw.name, count(pr) AS proteins ORDER BY proteins DESC LIMIT 10

name: Drug with most gene interactions
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN d.name, count(g) AS targets ORDER BY targets DESC LIMIT 10

name: Drug with most side effects
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN d.name, count(se) AS side_effects ORDER BY side_effects DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most common side effects
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) RETURN se.name, count(d) AS drugs ORDER BY drugs DESC LIMIT 10

name: Drug → Gene → Protein pathway
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WITH d, g LIMIT 5 MATCH (p:Protein) WHERE p.gene_name = g.gene_name RETURN d.name, g.gene_name, p.name LIMIT 10

name: Drug side effects → Gene targets for same drug
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(se:SideEffect) WHERE se.name = 'Nausea' WITH d LIMIT 5 MATCH (d)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN d.name, g.gene_name LIMIT 10

name: Surveillance: cholera outbreaks top countries
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'cholera' AND dr.year = 2023 RETURN c.name, dr.value ORDER BY dr.value DESC LIMIT 10

name: Surveillance: vaccine coverage vs outbreaks
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(vc:VaccineCoverage) WHERE vc.antigen CONTAINS 'DTP3' AND vc.year = 2023 WITH c, vc.coverage_pct AS dtp3 MATCH (c)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport) WHERE dr.year = 2023 RETURN c.name, dtp3, dr.value AS cases ORDER BY dtp3 ASC LIMIT 10

name: Surveillance: TB incidence trend India
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: 'IND'})-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'Tuberculosis' RETURN dr.year, dr.value ORDER BY dr.year DESC LIMIT 10

name: Health Determinants: Gini inequality top 10
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'SI.POV.GINI' AND s.year = 2020 RETURN c.name, s.value ORDER BY s.value DESC LIMIT 10

name: Health Determinants: forest area vs PM2.5
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(f:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE f.indicator_code = 'AG.LND.FRST.ZS' AND f.year = 2020 WITH c, f.value AS forest MATCH (c)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(pm:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE pm.indicator_code = 'EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3' AND pm.year = 2019 RETURN c.name, forest, pm.value AS pm25 ORDER BY pm25 DESC LIMIT 10

name: Health Determinants: fertility vs infant mortality
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(fr:DemographicProfile) WHERE fr.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.TFRT.IN' AND fr.year = 2022 WITH c, fr.value AS fertility MATCH (c)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(im:DemographicProfile) WHERE im.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.IMRT.IN' AND im.year = 2022 RETURN c.name, fertility, im.value AS infant_mortality ORDER BY fertility DESC LIMIT 10

name: Health Systems: workforce density top physicians
cypher: MATCH (h:HealthWorkforce)-[:SERVES]->(c:Country) WHERE h.profession = 'physicians' AND h.year = 2020 RETURN c.name, h.density_per_10k ORDER BY h.density_per_10k DESC LIMIT 10

name: Health Systems: workforce density lowest nurses
cypher: MATCH (h:HealthWorkforce)-[:SERVES]->(c:Country) WHERE h.profession = 'nursing_midwifery' AND h.year = 2020 RETURN c.name, h.density_per_10k ORDER BY h.density_per_10k ASC LIMIT 10

name: 6KG: India full profile (determinants + systems + surveillance)
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country {iso_code: 'IND'})-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD' AND s.year = 2022 WITH s.value AS gni MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c2:Country {iso_code: 'IND'}) WHERE e.year = 2023 WITH gni, avg(e.score) AS avg_spar MATCH (c3:Country {iso_code: 'IND'})-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport) WHERE dr.year = 2023 RETURN gni, avg_spar, count(dr) AS disease_reports

name: 6KG: Nigeria full profile
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country {iso_code: 'NGA'})-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD' AND s.year = 2022 WITH s.value AS gni MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c2:Country {iso_code: 'NGA'}) WHERE e.year = 2023 WITH gni, avg(e.score) AS avg_spar MATCH (c3:Country {iso_code: 'NGA'})-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport) WHERE dr.year = 2023 RETURN gni, avg_spar, count(dr) AS disease_reports

name: 6KG: poverty → disease burden correlation
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(pov:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE pov.indicator_code = 'SI.POV.DDAY' AND pov.value > 30 AND pov.year = 2019 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, c1.name AS name, pov.value AS poverty ORDER BY poverty DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (c2:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND dr.year = 2023 RETURN name, poverty, count(dr) AS disease_reports ORDER BY poverty DESC

name: 6KG: stunting → vaccine coverage
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country)-[:NUTRITION_STATUS]->(n:NutritionIndicator) WHERE n.indicator_code = 'SH.STA.STNT.ZS' AND n.year = 2020 AND n.value > 30 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, c1.name AS name, n.value AS stunting ORDER BY stunting DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (c2:Country)-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(vc:VaccineCoverage) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND vc.year = 2023 RETURN name, stunting, vc.antigen, vc.coverage_pct ORDER BY stunting DESC

name: 6KG: water stress → disease outbreaks
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country)-[:WATER_RESOURCE_OF]->(w:WaterResource) WHERE w.indicator_code = 'ER.H2O.FWTL.ZS' AND w.value > 80 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, c1.name AS name, w.value AS water_stress MATCH (c2:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND dr.year = 2023 AND d.name CONTAINS 'cholera' RETURN name, water_stress, dr.value AS cholera_cases

name: 6KG: physician density → infant mortality
cypher: MATCH (h:HealthWorkforce)-[:SERVES]->(c1:Country) WHERE h.profession = 'physicians' AND h.year = 2020 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, c1.name AS name, h.density_per_10k AS physicians ORDER BY physicians ASC LIMIT 10 MATCH (c2:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(im:DemographicProfile) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND im.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.IMRT.IN' AND im.year = 2022 RETURN name, physicians, im.value AS infant_mortality ORDER BY physicians ASC

name: 6KG: SPAR surveillance capacity → malaria cases
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c1:Country) WHERE e.capacity_code = 'C05' AND e.year = 2023 AND e.score < 50 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, c1.name AS name, e.score AS surveillance_score MATCH (c2:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND d.name CONTAINS 'malaria' AND dr.year = 2022 RETURN name, surveillance_score, dr.value AS malaria_cases ORDER BY malaria_cases DESC LIMIT 10

name: 6KG: health expenditure → life expectancy → SPAR
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(he:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE he.indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PC.CD' AND he.year = 2020 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, c1.name AS name, he.value AS health_spend ORDER BY health_spend ASC LIMIT 10 MATCH (c2:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(le:DemographicProfile) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND le.indicator_code = 'SP.DYN.LE00.IN' AND le.year = 2022 WITH iso, name, health_spend, le.value AS life_exp MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c3:Country) WHERE c3.iso_code = iso AND e.year = 2023 RETURN name, health_spend, life_exp, avg(e.score) AS avg_spar ORDER BY health_spend ASC

name: 6KG: urbanization → PM2.5 → disease burden
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(u:DemographicProfile) WHERE u.indicator_code = 'SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS' AND u.year = 2022 AND u.value > 70 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, c1.name AS name, u.value AS urban ORDER BY urban DESC LIMIT 10 MATCH (c2:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(pm:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND pm.indicator_code = 'EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3' AND pm.year = 2019 WITH iso, name, urban, pm.value AS pm25 MATCH (c3:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport) WHERE c3.iso_code = iso AND dr.year = 2023 RETURN name, urban, pm25, count(dr) AS reports ORDER BY urban DESC

name: Trial interventions → Drug interactions for same compound
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug {name: 'Aspirin'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) RETURN d.name, g.gene_name LIMIT 10

name: Pathways proteins → Drug gene targets overlap
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(pw:Pathway) WHERE pw.name CONTAINS 'Signaling' WITH p.gene_name AS gene LIMIT 20 MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INTERACTS_WITH_GENE]->(g:Gene) WHERE g.gene_name = gene RETURN gene, d.name ORDER BY gene LIMIT 10

name: Clinical trial conditions → Surveillance diseases
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(cond:Condition) WHERE cond.name CONTAINS 'Tuberculosis' WITH count(t) AS tb_trials MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: 'IND'})-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'Tuberculosis' AND dr.year = 2023 RETURN tb_trials, dr.value AS india_tb_cases

name: Drug adverse events → Surveillance disease patterns
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:HAS_ADVERSE_EVENT]->(ae:AdverseEvent) WITH d.name AS drug, count(ae) AS adverse_events ORDER BY adverse_events DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN drug, adverse_events

name: All KG node counts
cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n)[0] AS label, count(n) AS count ORDER BY count DESC

name: All KG edge type counts
cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS edge_type, count(r) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20

name: Country node count (dedup check)
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) RETURN count(c) AS total_countries

name: Health Determinants: anemia prevalence highest
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:NUTRITION_STATUS]->(n:NutritionIndicator) WHERE n.indicator_code = 'SH.STA.ANEM.ZS' AND n.year = 2019 RETURN c.name, n.value ORDER BY n.value DESC LIMIT 10

name: Health Determinants: education vs health spend
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(edu:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE edu.indicator_code = 'SE.XPD.TOTL.GD.ZS' AND edu.year = 2020 WITH c, edu.value AS edu_spend MATCH (c)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(he:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE he.indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS' AND he.year = 2020 RETURN c.name, edu_spend, he.value AS health_spend ORDER BY edu_spend DESC LIMIT 10

name: Health Systems: SPAR capacity heatmap data
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c:Country {iso_code: 'IND'}) RETURN e.year, e.capacity_code, e.score ORDER BY e.year, e.capacity_code

name: Surveillance: life expectancy trend Brazil
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: 'BRA'})-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'Life expectancy' RETURN dr.year, dr.value ORDER BY dr.year DESC LIMIT 10

name: PubMed: citation network depth (2-hop)
cypher: MATCH (a1:Article)-[:CITES]->(a2:Article)-[:CITES]->(a3:Article) WHERE a1.pmid = '25000000' RETURN a2.pmid, a3.pmid, a3.title LIMIT 10

name: PubMed: grant agency distribution
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:FUNDED_BY]->(g:Grant) RETURN g.agency, count(a) AS articles ORDER BY articles DESC LIMIT 10

name: Clinical trial: phase distribution
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial) WHERE t.phase IS NOT NULL RETURN t.phase, count(t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC

name: Clinical trial: facilities per trial
cypher: MATCH (t:ClinicalTrial)-[:CONDUCTED_AT]->(f:Facility) WITH t, count(f) AS sites RETURN avg(sites) AS avg_sites_per_trial

name: Drug Interactions: drug class hierarchy
cypher: MATCH (d:Drug)-[:CLASSIFIED_AS]->(dc:DrugClass)-[:PARENT_CLASS]->(parent:DrugClass) RETURN dc.name, parent.name, count(d) AS drugs ORDER BY drugs DESC LIMIT 10

name: Pathways: reaction catalysis chain
cypher: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:CATALYZES]->(r:Reaction)-[:HAS_REACTION]->(pw:Pathway) RETURN pw.name, count(r) AS reactions ORDER BY reactions DESC LIMIT 10

name: 6KG: Brazil full profile
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country {iso_code: 'BRA'})-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(s:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE s.indicator_code = 'NY.GNP.PCAP.CD' AND s.year = 2022 WITH s.value AS gni MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c2:Country {iso_code: 'BRA'}) WHERE e.year = 2023 WITH gni, avg(e.score) AS avg_spar MATCH (c3:Country {iso_code: 'BRA'})-[:HAS_COVERAGE]->(vc:VaccineCoverage) WHERE vc.year = 2023 RETURN gni, avg_spar, count(vc) AS vaccine_records

name: 6KG: low SPAR + high poverty + low water
cypher: MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c1:Country) WHERE e.year = 2023 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, avg(e.score) AS spar WHERE spar < 60 WITH iso, spar ORDER BY spar ASC LIMIT 10 MATCH (c2:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(pov:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND pov.indicator_code = 'SI.POV.DDAY' WITH iso, spar, pov.value AS poverty MATCH (c3:Country)-[:WATER_RESOURCE_OF]->(w:WaterResource) WHERE c3.iso_code = iso AND w.indicator_code = 'SH.H2O.SMDW.ZS' AND w.year = 2022 RETURN c3.name, spar, poverty, w.value AS safe_water ORDER BY spar ASC

name: Surveillance: malaria cases trend Nigeria
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {iso_code: 'NGA'})-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport)-[:REPORT_OF]->(d:Disease) WHERE d.name CONTAINS 'malaria' RETURN dr.year, dr.value ORDER BY dr.year DESC LIMIT 10

name: Health Determinants: renewable energy top 10
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:ENVIRONMENT_OF]->(e:EnvironmentalFactor) WHERE e.indicator_code = 'EG.FEC.RNEW.ZS' AND e.year = 2020 RETURN c.name, e.value ORDER BY e.value DESC LIMIT 10

name: Health Determinants: population growth fastest
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)-[:DEMOGRAPHIC_OF]->(d:DemographicProfile) WHERE d.indicator_code = 'SP.POP.GROW' AND d.year = 2023 RETURN c.name, d.value ORDER BY d.value DESC LIMIT 10

name: 6KG: comprehensive vulnerability index (poverty + SPAR)
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(pov:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE pov.indicator_code = 'SI.POV.DDAY' AND pov.value > 20 AND pov.year = 2019 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, c1.name AS name, pov.value AS poverty ORDER BY poverty DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (e:EmergencyResponse)-[:CAPACITY_FOR]->(c2:Country) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND e.year = 2023 RETURN name, poverty, avg(e.score) AS avg_spar ORDER BY poverty DESC
